Jordan H: Heads-up — CS asked for an org-scoped view showing token-level latency, per-route KPIs, and KV cache hit ratios by workspace. They want RBACed links we can share with customers. Thoughts?

Anna L: +1. I ran a quick profile on tenant acme-uk this morning. Kernel switch at seq_len ~1024 jumps latency 1.6-1.8x on the tail. Flame graph link: https://internal.paste/fg/acme-uk (private). :mag:

Samir P: Can you paste the key numbers? suspect some requests are being routed to the int8 kernel even when fp16 would be faster for that seq/profile. Also we need per-org kernel_switch counters.

Anna L: Key numbers: p50 token latency 12ms, p95 48ms, p99 130ms. After kernel switch p95 rises to ~85ms. I captured a cpu/gpu timeline too.

Mike R: FYI batching heuristic currently caps per-tenant batch to 64 concurrent tokens. For small seq lengths that underfills the GPU. Proposal: dynamic target batch = min(global_max_batch, ceil(target_throughput / avg_seq_len_per_org)).

Samir P: For dashboards I'd add these queries (Grafana/PromQL style) — shareable panels per-org: 
```
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(token_latency_bucket{env="prod"}[5m])) by (le, org_id))
```
KV cache hit ratio: 
```
sum by (org_id) (rate(kv_cache_hits_total{env="prod"}[5m])) / sum by (org_id) (rate(kv_cache_requests_total{env="prod"}[5m]))
```
Kernel switch rate per org: 
```
sum by (org_id) (rate(kernel_switch_count_total{env="prod"}[5m]))
```

Jordan H: Those look good. We also need per-route KPIs (route_id or model_id + org_id): token_cost_per_route, tokens_generated_per_route, avg_latency_per_route. Make sure panels allow splitting by org_id but respect RBAC.

Anna L: On the perf-regression front — FYI the rollout yesterday included a kernel-selection change. We saw a 7% p95 regression for orgs with >30 concurrent streams (repro on staging). Rolled back the selection tweak at 09:30. Need a metric to alert on sudden p95 delta per org (delta vs baseline).

Samir P: Alert idea: alert if p95_latency_org / p95_latency_org_baseline > 1.2 for 10m, and kernel_switch_rate_org increases by >50% in same window. That would catch SSOs where kernel thrash causes tails.

Mike R: UI/ops note — make panels templated: org_id and team_view. Admins get org selector across all; customer links only show single org row. Use signed, time-limited links for customers.

Anna L: I'll add panels to the runtime dashboard (token-level histogram, kv hit ratio, kernel switches, per-route heatmap). Samir — can you add the PromQLs to the metrics repo and a short README?

Samir P: Yep. I'll open a PR with queries + an example dashboard JSON fragment.

Jordan H: Action items: Anna -> dashboard panels + sample org view. Samir -> metrics PR and alert rules. Mike -> design note for RBAC/signed links. I'll coordinate with CS for the first customer pilot.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment for runtime-metrics v2026.02.14 completed in eu-west-1 :white_check_mark:

infra-bot: Noted — creating org-scoped Prometheus job labeler for runtime metrics to ensure consistent org_id tagging.

Mike R: One more thing — add a synthetic test that sends mixed seq lengths for each org to surface batching-induced tail regressions. Small script idea: send 70% short (64) + 30% long (1024) sequences at target concurrency and track p95.

Jordan H: Perfect. Let's reconvene after the dashboard + PR. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
